title: Frontend Developer
description: Build responsive, accessible web interfaces for our SaaS analytics platform. You will work closely with designers and backend engineers to ship pixel-perfect, performant UI components and improve our design system.

title: Backend Developer
description: Design and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that power our cloud infrastructure dashboard. You will own services end-to-end, from data model to deployment, with a strong focus on reliability and observability.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Work across the stack on our modern developer tools platform: React frontends, Node.js and Python APIs, and relational databases. Ideal for engineers who enjoy owning features from database to browser.

title: Python Developer
description: Develop data processing scripts, automated pipelines, and internal tools in Python. You will clean, transform, and move data between services and expose results through clean microservice APIs.

title: Data Analyst
description: Turn raw business data into actionable dashboards and insights for enterprise clients. You will write complex SQL queries, build automated reporting pipelines, and present findings to key stakeholders.

title: Data Scientist
description: Build predictive models, recommendation systems, and customer behavior insights. You will own the full data science lifecycle: exploratory analysis, feature engineering, model tuning, and production evaluation.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Deploy, scale, and monitor state-of-the-art machine learning models in production environments. Work on model serving optimization, continuous training pipelines, and low-latency inference.

title: AI Engineer
description: Integrate cutting-edge LLMs and generative AI capabilities into enterprise software products. Build agentic workflows, RAG architectures, prompt pipelines, and evaluation metrics.

title: Software Engineer
description: Join our core platform engineering team to build scalable software applications, write clean unit-tested code, optimize algorithmic performance, and collaborate on system architecture.

title: Business Analyst
description: Bridge the gap between technology teams and business executives. Document business requirements, perform process mapping, analyze performance metrics, and prepare executive summaries.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Craft intuitive user experiences, interactive wireframes, and high-fidelity design systems for consumer web and mobile products. Partner with engineers to bring designs into reality.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate build, test, and release cycles while maintaining cloud infrastructure resilience. Implement robust CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and continuous monitoring.

title: Java Developer
description: Develop high-throughput enterprise backend microservices using Java and Spring Boot. You will ensure thread safety, robust database transactions, and high availability under load.

title: React Developer
description: Specialized frontend developer focused on high-performance React web applications, state management, complex forms, and reusable component libraries.

title: Data Engineer
description: Architect and maintain robust data pipelines, ETL workflows, and lakehouse infrastructure. Cleanse and model terabytes of structured and semi-structured business data.
